In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
osmium tetroxyde reacts with dsDNA in the presence of 1,10 phenanthroline and that this reaction is preceded by intercalation of the osmium complex.
the covalent binding to double-stranded B-form DNA by Os,phen involves the formation of a covalent bond between the osmium metal and the nucleobase of the DNA molecule.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Os,phen complex reacts with dsDNA, and that the binding of Os, phen to dsDNA is covalent.
Os,phen binds to dsDNA and ssDNA with different affinities and the binding to dsDNA is accompanied by a covalent attachment.
Os,phen reacts with double-strand DNA, and this reaction is preceded by a noncovalent DNA structural modification.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Os,phen is a useful reagent for probing DNA structure and for the chemical modification of DNA.
Os,phen binds covalently not only to single-stranded DNA but also to double-stranded B-type DNA.
Os,phen is an efficient and specific probe for double-stranded DNA in vitro.
